nombre_oficial.texto: Palaces and Neighborhoods of the West

frase_gancho.texto: Life behind the walls: families, jaguars, warriors, and Zapotecs.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Southwest of the Avenue, across the outer circuit, lie the apartment compounds that reveal how the people of Teotihuacán lived. At Zacuala and Yayahuala, you will discover how up to a hundred relatives lived under one roof, with their dead buried beneath the floor. A few steps away, the walls of Tetitla and Atetelco await you with original paintings of jaguar-men, hands pouring out jade, and processions of coyotes and warrior pumas. The visit is completed by the stories of La Ventilla and of the Zapotec enclave of Tlailotlacan.
